visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark brown bowl-cut hair, wearing a black medical mask and a bright royal blue puffer jacket with a thick white fleece lining, is seated inside a car at night. He gestures energetically with both hands, holding two thousand-dollar bills (New Taiwan Dollars) while looking directly at the camera. The background shows dark car windows and an overhead interior light. White subtitles with yellow emphasis appear at the bottom of the frame. (2) The scene transitions to the interior of a lottery retail shop. The man's hand places the cash on a yellow counter top over a glass display containing stacks of red and gold lottery tickets. He points at a specific ticket labeled '2000萬超級紅包'. The shopkeeper's hand enters from the side to pull out a ticket. The lighting is bright and industrial. (3) The man is now indoors, wearing a black long-sleeve shirt and the same mask, sitting on a red leather sofa. He places the large lottery ticket on a low wooden table and begins scratching the silver coating off with a coin. He moves his hands rapidly in a repetitive scrubbing motion. (4) The camera focuses on the lottery ticket as he scratches 'Game 4'. He leans his head down closely, his eyes widening and narrowing as he inspects the numbers. A purple and pink section of the ticket is revealed, showing the number '1,000,000'. A variety-style text overlay '突然!!' appears. (5) The man jumps back in shock, his eyes wide with surprise. He looks at the camera, then back at the ticket, holding it up with both hands. The video ends with a close-up of the ticket confirming the '$1,000,000' win amount and the man shouting in celebration.
